newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Yasser Arafat to visit Sri Lanka next week.
newsitem.headline: Yasser Arafat to visit Sri Lanka next week.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is to travel to Sri Lanka next week on a two-day official visit, the foreign ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
It said Arafat, who arrives on Monday, would call on Sri Lankan President Chandrika Kumaratunga and Prime Minister Sirima Bandaranaike during his stay.
Arafat, who is also scheduled to speak at a public function on Monday, will travel to Colombo from Islamabad, it said.
The Palestinian president is currently embroiled in a major diplomatic row with Israel over Tel Aviv's decision to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
